messages.subject: Re: Build failed in Jenkins: Stan Distribution Tests #475
parts:
This looks like a stale file from the previous build.  It may need some manual poking.


On Fri, Jan 3, 2014 at 8:21 PM, <mc.sta...@gmail.com> wrote:
See <http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Stan%20Distribution%20Tests/475/changes>

Changes:

[Daniel Lee] Test mdivide_{left|right}_ldlt and log_determinant_ldlt.

[Daniel Lee] Split trace_gen_quad_form tests into their own files.

[Daniel Lee] Add unit tests for trace_inv_quad_form_ldlt and fix derivative error.

[Daniel Lee] Rename trace_inv_quad_form_ldlt with three arguments to trace_gen_inv_quad_form_ldlt to be consistent with the non-inverse form of the trace-of-quadratic-form functions.

[Daniel Lee] Rename test functions to be consistent.

[Daniel Lee] Unit test for trace_gen_inv_quad_form_ldlt.

[Daniel Lee] Expand testing for multi_student_t_log.

[Daniel Lee] Use LDLT_factor in multi_normal_log again now that the gradients are fixed.

[Daniel Lee] Use trace_inv_quad_form_ldlt() in multi_student_t.

[Daniel Lee] Fix function call in multi_gp_log.

[Daniel Lee] Fix memory issue with log_determiant_ldlt_test.cpp

[Daniel Lee] split apart src/stan/math/matrix/ldlt.hpp into 6 header files; created test files for the missing ones (no tests included)

[Daniel Lee] split src/stan/agrad/rev/matrix/ldlt.hpp into 6 header files; created test files for missing tests (no tests included)

[Daniel Lee] added failing finite diff test for agrad mdivide_left_ldlt

[marcus.a.brubaker] Fix LDLT finite difference tests.

[Daniel Lee] added more tests for log_determinant

[Daniel Lee] added test for trace_gen_inv_quad_form_ldlt using basic math and auto-diff

[Daniel Lee] changed include order of multiply

[Daniel Lee] testing mdivide_right_ldlt. tests fail

[Daniel Lee] adding math test for trace_inv_quad_form_ldlt

[Daniel Lee] added tests for trace_inv_quad_form_ldlt for gradients checking against auto-diff implementation

[marcus.a.brubaker] Fix mdivide_right_ldlt unit test.

[marcus.a.brubaker] use mdivide_right_spd instead of inverse to test gradients.

[bg2382] add some code comments

[marcus.a.brubaker] Add some comments on how LDLT_factor should be used.

[bg2382] add .vectorD() method to LDLT

[bg2382] use check_ldlt_factor() in distributions

[bg2382] forgot to commit check_ldlt_factor.hpp

[marcus.a.brubaker] Change types to silence new compiler warnings.

[marcus.a.brubaker] ASSERT_TRUE on LDLT_factor::success() in unit tests.

[marcus.a.brubaker] Forgot to commit this file, silences warnings.

[mbrubake] Add some more API documentation to LDLT_factor and LDLT_alloc.

[marcus.a.brubaker] Unit test for LDLT_alloc.

[Daniel Lee] adding more tests for LDLT_alloc

[Daniel Lee] Adding LDLT_factor test that breaks. Not just fails, but breaks

[marcus.a.brubaker] Check that a factorization attempt has happend in success()

[marcus.a.brubaker] Expand documentation to make it clear that you must call compute() if you use the default constructor.

[Daniel Lee] added stronger language indicating that success() must be true before using the other functions within LDLT_factor
